subject.title: Chat context popover: show Anthropic plan usage (5h/weekly/credits) instead of meaningless cost on subscription billing

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled issue be implemented as a narrow subscription-usage popover fix now, or folded into the broader chat token/quota widget direction?
rationale: The source gap is concrete, but the protected label and overlap with broader chat quota UI work mean automation should not choose the permanent UI boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Implement narrow popover fix
options.body: Map `claude-cli` usage to Anthropic and extend the existing popover to show provider plan windows, resets, and billing entries when subscription usage snapshots exist.

options.title: Fold into broader widget work
options.body: Track this as a subcase of the broader chat token/quota widget so one design covers all providers and alert semantics.

options.title: Keep details on Usage page
options.body: Keep the chat popover compact and direct users to the Usage page for full provider-window and billing details.

recommendation.title: Implement narrow popover fix
recommendation.body: Map `claude-cli` usage to Anthropic and extend the existing popover to show provider plan windows, resets, and billing entries when subscription usage snapshots exist.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest provider-usage history signal and opened this maintainer-labeled issue with the concrete desired behavior.
